hospital: Baptist Health South Florida (Baptist Hospital of Miami)
title: Financial Assistance Policy BHSF-355.14, revised 09/29/2026

uninsured-only.quote: The designation of uninsured does not extend to a patient for the patient's out-of-pocket obligation for co-pays, deductibles or co-insurance.

applies-to.quote: This policy applies to patient service charges which no health insurance or any other payor source

levels.quote: Family income of 200% FPL or less 100% Special needs financial assistance 2 Vice President of Revenue Management Family income of 200 to 300% FPL 100%

free-care.quote: Patients qualifying for financial assistance under this policy receive a 100% discount (i.e., free care).

window.quote: ends on the later of the 240th day after the date that the first post-discharge billing statement for the care is provided or at least 30 days after Baptist Health provides the individual with a written notice

refund.quote: Refund any payments received for the service covered by the financial assistance approval (unless such excess amount is less than $5

facility-only.quote: This policy applies only to facility charges and employed physician charges.
